sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SERN U.S. RIDGE WILL RETROGRESS TO THE LWR MS VLY/NRN GULF THIS PERIOD AS ONT SHORTWAVE TROUGH CONTINUES E INTO QUE AND LOWERS HEIGHTS ALONG THE E CST. AT THE SAME TIME...BROAD TROUGH WILL PERSIST OVER THE ERN PACIFIC NEAR 130W...WHILE SHORTWAVE IMPULSE ON THE E SIDE OF THE SYSTEM CONTINUES N/NE FROM NRN CA INTO ORE/ID. AT LWR LVLS...COLD FRONT WITH ONT TROUGH WILL MOVE STEADILY E/SE ACROSS THE GRT LKS/OH VLY...PRECEDED OVER THE OH VLY BY WEAKENING COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM YESTERDAY'S STORMS.

sections.title: MIDWEST/LWR GRT LKS TO NWRN NEW ENGLAND AFTN/EVE
sections.text: TSTMS SHOULD REDEVELOP ALONG AFOREMENTIONED COLD FRONT AND/OR ALONG LINGERING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY SEGMENTS BY EARLY AFTN FROM NRN IL/IND ENE TO THE LWR GRT LKS. LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH ONT TROUGH LARGELY WILL REMAIN N OF THE CANADIAN BORDER...AND WILL NOT BE JUXTAPOSED WITH THE STRONGEST LOW LVL MOISTURE INFLOW /DESTABILIZATION OVER THE MIDWEST/LWR GRT LKS. WITHIN THIS REGIME...MID LVL LAPSE RATES WILL REMAIN WEAK. NEVERTHELESS... MODERATE/DEEP UNIDIRECTIONAL WLY FLOW AND STRONG SFC HEATING SHOULD FOSTER ORGANIZATION OF STORMS INTO BANDS. EMBEDDED BOWING SEGMENTS WILL BE CAPABLE OF DMGG WIND GUSTS LATER THIS AFTN THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT.

sections.title: NRN GRT BASIN/INTERMOUNTAIN REGION AFTN/EVE
sections.text: ASCENT FROM NRN CA SHORTWAVE IMPULSE SHOULD REACH THE ORE/ID BORDER BY PEAK HEATING. RELATIVELY MOIST ENVIRONMENT /PW TO ONE INCH/...LARGE SCALE ASCENT...STRENGTHENING WIND FIELD /30-35 KT SW FLOW AT 500 MB/...AND SEASONABLY COOL MID LVL TEMPERATURES SHOULD SUPPORT NUMEROUS STORMS OVER INTERIOR ORE AND ADJACENT PARTS OF ID AND PERHAPS SE WA BY AFTN. SETUP MAY SUPPORT A FEW SUPERCELLS WITH HAIL...AS WELL AS SMALL CLUSTERS OF STORMS WITH BOWING SEGMENTS/HIGH WIND...THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT.

sections.title: CNTRL RCKYS TO NRN/CNTRL HI PLNS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: FRONT THAT STALLED OVER THE REGION YESTERDAY HAS LEFT A CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY HIGH PW /1.00-1.25 INCHES/ OVER PARTS OF MT...WY...CO AND THE NRN HALF OF THE HI PLNS. SFC HEATING...TERRAIN CIRCULATIONS ...AND ASCENT PROVIDED BY WEAK IMPULSES ON FRINGE OF MS VLY RIDGE MAY SUPPORT SCTD STRONG DIURNAL STORMS BENEATH 20-30 KT WSW FLOW ALOFT OVER THE RCKYS. FARTHER E...DIURNALLY-ENHANCED UPSLOPE FLOW MAY FOSTER AFTN/EVE STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE WY/NRN CO FRONT RANGE AND ADJACENT HI PLNS... WHERE A FEW SUPERCELLS COULD OCCUR. ONE OR TWO OF THESE STORMS COULD PERSIST INTO MID/LATE EVE... ESPECIALLY OVER NE WY/WRN SD...WHERE LARGE SCALE ASCENT MAY BE ENHANCED BY DEVELOPMENT OF HIGH LVL JET ENTRANCE REGION OVER THE DAKOTAS. BUT COMPARATIVELY WARM MID LVL TEMPERATURES AND WEAK LOW LVL CONVERGENCE SUGGEST THAT SVR THREAT SHOULD REMAIN ISOLD/UNORGANIZED.

sections.title: TN VLY TO GA/CAROLINAS AFTN
sections.text: A FEW STRONG/SVR DIURNAL STORMS CAPABLE OF ISOLD DOWNBURSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE INVOF DIFFUSE FRONT STALLED OVER REGION. BUT FLOW ALOFT AND LOW LVL DESTABILIZATION EXPECTED TO BE WEAKER RELATIVE TO PAST TWO DAYS...THUS SVR THREAT SHOULD BE REDUCED. ..CORFIDI/STOPPKOTTE.. 07/28/2010

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LARGE SUMMERTIME UPPER HIGH DOMINATES MUCH OF U.S. WITH THE CENTER GRADUALLY DEVELOPING WWD ACROSS SRN PLAINS. SYSTEM MOVING EWD ACROSS SERN CANADA PROVIDING SOME HEIGHT FALLS AND STRONGER FLOW FROM GREAT LAKES TO NEW ENGLAND. LARGE SCALE TROUGH REMAINS OFF W COAST AS S/WV IMPULSE/VORT MAX MOVING NNEWD FROM CURRENT POSITION NRN CA THRU ERN ORE THIS AFTERNOON TO NRN ID/NWRN MT BY THU AM.

sections.title: MIDWEST/LWR GRT LAKES TO NWRN NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: COLD FRONT AT 16Z EXTENDS WSWWD FROM LH TO SRN WI...ACROSS NWRN KS TO ERN CO. VERY MOIST AIR MASS IS SPREADING EWD ACROSS OH VALLEY TO AS FAR E AS WRN NEW ENGLAND BY LATER TODAY IN ADVANCE OF THE COLD FRONT. WITH DAYTIME HEATING...INSTABILITY WILL ALSO INCREASE SUFFICIENTLY TO SUPPORT AN ORGANIZED BAND OF THUNDERSTORMS TO DEVELOP IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE FRONTAL CONVERGENCE. WHILE THE STRONGER FLOW WILL REMAIN GENERALLY N OF THE FRONT AND OVERALL LAPSE RATES WILL REMAIN WEAK...THE 30 KT OF MID LEVEL FLOW COUPLED WITH MLCAPES UPWARDS TO 2000 J/KG WILL FOSTER ORGANIZATION OF STORMS INTO BANDS. EMBEDDED BOWING SEGMENTS WILL BE CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS FROM MID AFTERNOON THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT. GREATEST THREAT OF WIND DAMAGE VICINITY LE WHERE BETTER COMBO OF INSTABILITY/SHEAR WILL BE POSITIONED ALONG WITH ENHANCED CONVERGENCE OF THE LAKE BREEZE FRONT.

sections.title: NRN GREAT BASIN/INTERMOUNTAIN REGION THIS AFTERNOON/EVE
sections.text: CONSIDERABLE GENERALLY WEAK CONVECTION HAS DEVELOPED IN ADVANCE OF NRN CA IMPULSE THIS MORNING IN RESPONSE TO ASSOCIATED LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND ELEVATED CAPES FROM 500-1000 J/KG. WITH HEATING... LAPSE RATES WILL STEEPEN AND STRENGTHEN THUNDERSTORMS BY MID AFTERNOON INCREASING THE LIKELIHOOD OF NOT ONLY LARGE HAIL BUT WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL. SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR TO 40KT FOR STORM ROTATION WITH THE STRONGEST UPDRAFTS. THIS WOULD ENHANCE BOTH THE WIND AND HAIL POTENTIAL. BY MID AFTERNOON WHEN THE CONVECTIVE THREAT WOULD BE MAXIMIZED...VORT MAX WILL BE TRACKING NNEWD THRU ERN OR. HAVE EXTENDED THE SLIGHT RISK EWD INTO SERN ID GIVEN THE AVAILABLE MOISTURE/INSTABILITY MOVING NWD FROM UT/NERN NV...EVEN THOUGH SHEAR WILL BE A LITTLE WEAKER.

sections.title: TN VLY TO GA/CAROLINA'S
sections.text: WITH A CONTINUED VERY MOIST AND POTENTIALLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS ACROSS THE AREA...SCATTERED DIURNAL STORMS WILL AGAIN OCCUR. GREATEST THREAT OF DOWNBURST WINDS WILL BE IN AREAS THAT HAVE THE LEAST MORNING CLOUD COVER TO IMPEDE THE HEATING PROCESS. SHEAR IS WEAK SO SVR THREAT WILL CONTINUE TO BE OF THE PULSE VARIETY. ..HALES/ROGERS.. 07/28/2010

sections.title: MIDWEST/LOWER GREAT LAKES TO NWRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: NO MAJOR CHANGES NEEDED TO PREVIOUS FORECAST. MULTIPLE BANDS OF THUNDERSTORMS HAVE FORMED THIS AFTERNOON ALONG/AHEAD OF A SEWD MOVING COLD FRONT. THROUGH THIS EVENING...THE STRONGEST STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO AFFECT NE IND...NRN OH AND PERHAPS NW PA AND W NY. STORMS WILL BE EMBEDDED IN MODEST UNIDIRECTIONAL WLY FLOW REGIME. WHILE AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL IS POSSIBLE...PRIMARY STORM MODE WILL BE BOWING LINE SEGMENTS GIVING DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: NRN GREAT BASIN/INTERMOUNTAIN REGION
sections.text: NO CHANGES TO PREVIOUS FORECAST. 18Z BOISE SOUNDING WAS CAPPED...OWING TO PASSAGE OF AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM MORNING PRECIPITATION. HOWEVER...ROBUST UPDRAFTS WERE DEVELOPING ON THE SOUTHWEST HIGHLANDS OF ID AND AIR MASS WILL CONTINUE TO DESTABILIZE...ESPECIALLY DOWNSTREAM OVER THE MAGIC VALLEY AND ADJACENT SAWTOOTH MOUNTAIN REGION. FARTHER W...AT LEAST ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS WILL ALSO FORM ALONG THE TAIL-END OF THE DEPARTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH ACROSS SERN ORE AND TRANSLATE NWD ACROSS ERN ORE DURING THE EVENING. WIND FIELDS WILL BE MORE THAN ADEQUATE FOR ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING BRIEF SUPERCELLS AND BOW ECHOES CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS...PARTICULARLY OVER ID. REST OF FORECAST REMAINS UNCHANGED. /JPR ..RACY/HALES/ROGERS.. 07/28/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1105 AM CDT WED JUL 28 2010/
